data.summary: “🐱 Silvervine sticks for playful, happy cats! 🌿✨” has pulled 69,844,472 views at ~863,413/hour — well above a normal upload. It reads as a ASMR whose strongest lever is hook. The breakdown below frames the rest as likely contributors, not proven causes.

why_trending.detail: The first second of the title promises a clear, specific payoff, which likely earns the early swipe-through that short-form distribution rewards.
Views are accumulating far faster than a typical upload, and that early velocity likely compounds into broader recommendation.
The setup withholds the resolution, likely driving rewatches and completion — both strong short-form ranking signals.
The framing targets a broad, relatable everyday situation, which likely widens the share-and-comment audience.
The topic taps a timely, high-interest subject, so audience intent is likely already searching for and engaging with it.
